messages:
Amal: alarm — we started seeing a surge of mTLS handshake failures from apac proxies at ~02:37 UTC, a bunch of internal 502s. anyone oncall?
Kevin: seeing it in ap-northeast-1 too. logs show 'KMS decrypt denied' during cert fetch. snippet:
```
proxy[0] ERROR tls_handshake.go:89: tls: failed to verify client certificate: remote error: unknown certificate
trace=5a1c4f
```
Priya: can you share trace id and the KMS deny log? i'll check RBAC and KMS audit.
Kevin: trace=5a1c4f, and KMS event:
```
2026-03-23T02:37:12Z KMS Decrypt Deny principal=svc-proxy-apac@infra.svc region=ap-northeast-1 key=keystore-main request_id=ef45b
```
Jordan: we did a cluster-level RBAC pruning in the apac rollout last night to remove broad keystore roles. it's likely some proxy SA lost keystore-unwrap.
Amal: rotator-bot says proxies haven't fetched ephemeral certs in apac since 02:35. oncall-bot: INC-20260323-007 created (apac mTLS failures).
Priya: immediate plan: 1) re-grant keystore-unwrap to affected proxy SAs in apac, 2) restart rotator and audit-forwarder on canary nodes to push backlog, 3) enable a short-term TLS fallback for internal health routes to reduce customer impact.
Kevin: applying RoleBinding now (will paste manifest):
```
apiVersion: rbac.authorization.k8s.io/v1
kind: RoleBinding
metadata:
  name: proxy-keystore-unwrap-apac-temp
  namespace: infra-proxy
subjects:
- kind: ServiceAccount
  name: proxy
  namespace: infra-proxy
roleRef:
  kind: Role
  name: keystore-unwrap
  apiGroup: rbac.authorization.k8s.io
```
Jordan: please make the patch timeboxed (15m) and open a revert PR after incident. Also add a canary check in the RBAC rollout job to run a simple keystore unwrap check.
Amal: after RBAC bind + rotator restart I see successful decrypts at 02:44 UTC and proxies refetching certs. audit-forwarder shows backlog replay starting.
Priya: for compliance we need to ensure no KMS allow events were missed. follow-up: 1) replay audit-forwarder backlog to the central audit S3, 2) run a targeted log-compare for request_ids between 02:30-02:50 in apac, 3) produce an MD with timeline and affected service accounts. I'll own the audit backfill.
Kevin: also adding a metric: KMS Decrypt Deny count by region and role; if it exceeds 5 in 5m, page eng-security. making an alert now.
Jordan: longer-term actions: - update RBAC rollout playbook to require audit-forwarder health & trailing logs validation during canary, - add a keystore-sanity probe to the k8s rollout job, - add a graceful-degrade route for non-sensitive internal traffic.
Amal: agreed. Incident closed once audit backfill completes and alert is live. leaving open until Priya confirms. :white_check_mark:
Priya: confirmed backfill completed at 03:20 UTC, created postmortem draft and PR to add RBAC canary checks. closing INS-20260323-007 after PM review.
rotator-bot: rotator reconcile run: proxies-apac reissued 124 ephemeral certs, no subsequent handshake failures detected.
oncall-bot: Incident INC-20260323-007 resolved (root cause: RBAC rollout removed keystore-unwrap from proxy SAs causing KMS decrypt denies; remediation: temporary RoleBinding and rotator restart; follow-ups assigned).
